scope: Host contracts, real Node WebSocket transport and exact page-SDK wiring; physical Safari/Chrome acceptance remains open
change: Opt-in network capture attaches to up to32 existing live sockets tracked by the page SDK, in addition to newly created sockets. Known fields are scrubbed; binary payloads remain marked binary.
idle: No payload listeners are added until explicit network capture starts; listeners detach on stop/expiry/release. SDK retains bounded metadata discovery separately.
coverage: status.coverage.sockets reports discovery availability/failure, existing/new socket watch counts and active capture listeners
limits: Sockets created before page SDK boot or through captured constructor references remain undiscoverable unless they are otherwise supplied.
Native adapter has no existing-socket registry; native existing receive coverage is not claimed.
Fresh browser document required; no old page or native app was reloaded/rebuilt.
No physical iOS/WebSocket/provider-call/off-LAN qualification is claimed.
